content: Hello, thanks for contacting account support. How can I assist you today?
Hi, I need help resetting my password for my client portal account.
Of course. To get started, could you provide your registered username or email address?
My username is jsmith22 and my email is john.smith@email.com.
Thank you, John. I’ve sent a password reset link to your email address. Please check your inbox and click on the link.
I found the email and clicked the reset link. It’s asking me to set a new password.
Great! Please enter a new password that meets our security requirements, then confirm it and submit the form.
Perfect. You should now be able to log in using your username and new password. Is there anything else I can help you with?
No, that’s all. Thanks for your help!
